    sumx = sum([x**2 for x in X])

    y_mean = np.mean(y)

def gradient_descent_optimizer(X, y, theta, alpha, num_iterations):
    m = len(y)
    for i in range(num_iterations):
        h = np.dot(X,theta)
        loss = h-y
        grad = np.dot(X.T,loss)/m
        theta = theta - alpha*grad
    return theta
